verdict.rationale: Pandoc's own docs say it ships a Haskell library alongside the CLI, and that it can be compiled with an HTTP server mode (pandoc-server), so a programmatic API exists. The evidence only mentions these in passing: no API reference or endpoint documentation is shown, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: documented server endpoints/API reference, OpenAPI or machine-readable spec, evidence of library API docs, hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Pandoc includes a Haskell library and a standalone command-line program.
server: compile in support for running in HTTP server mode when the executable is renamed (or symlinked as) pandoc-server.
